description.value:
Trigger A non-sekmin creature without Nuzial's sigil moves adjacent to the door

Effect The trap attempts to place a lingering hypnotic vision of the serpent's eye in the minds of all creatures within a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 day. This effect can be counteracted with a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Clear Mind] spell.

Failure As success, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] on the first round of any encounter.

Critical Failure As failure, except the duration is 1 week.

details.description: The circle opens to reveal a slitted serpent's eye, which begins to spin in hypnotizing fashion.
details.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:29] (expert) to carefully cover the eye without triggering the hazard, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dispel Magic] (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the magic
details.reset: The trap resets when the door is opened and closed.
